properties.summary: No approved footprints are published, so this is an illustrative envelope: BART's parcels drawn to the 80-ft height limit of Berkeley's R-BMU district. Real buildings will cover less of the land.
properties.note: A height-limit envelope: no design has been filed.
properties.license: Parcels: BART public ArcGIS Online service (no license stated); existing buildings: OpenStreetMap contributors (ODbL 1.0), via Overture Maps

properties.label: Ashby West Lot
properties.source: illustrative: the West Lot parcel drawn to the R-BMU zoning district's 80-ft / 7-story maximum (BMC 23.202.150(F)), as stated in the City of Berkeley's Preliminary Objective Design Standards for the Ashby West Lot, Dec 2024, Sec. 1.2 (https://www.bart.gov/sites/default/files/2024-12/24_1210_AshbyTODPrelimODS.pdf)
properties.note: Developer selected July 2025; BART describes five buildings of 6 to 8 stories with up to 600 homes. No design has been filed with the City.
